visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a young woman with short dark hair and a cheerful expression, wearing a white lace dress. She is sitting on a light-colored sofa against a white faux-brick wall, holding a smartphone horizontally and showing a scene from a period drama to the camera. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot in a studio-like setting with white cabinets and professional filming equipment visible in the background. The woman stands up and gestures enthusiastically toward the camera while holding her phone. (3) A screen recording sequence shows the LINE messaging app interface for a chatbot called 'Chuan Zhen Ji'. The visual focus is on the digital keyboard and the chat interface where Chinese characters are being typed, followed by the bot returning lists of image codes and specific stills from a historical drama. (4) The woman reappears in a close-up, holding her phone vertically to demonstrate a 'random draw' feature. The screen shows a grid of text which then transitions into a funny, zoomed-in face of an emperor character from the drama, highlighted by the camera's focus.
